g.aria-label: Hold Qᵢ, mᵢ, sᵢ, Oᵢ (b × d_h) in SRAM
Stream Kⱼ, Vⱼ tiles from HBM
Never writes n × n scores to HBM!
O(n) Backward Pass via Log-Sum-Exp Recomputation
Forward pass saves only 1 scalar per query: ℓᵢ = mᵢ + log sᵢ ∈ ℝⁿ
Backward pass recomputes αᵢⱼ = exp(aᵢⱼ − ℓᵢ) on chip in SRAM — zero n × n buffer!
